'''Orimanther''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]]<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> that was visited by the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Phylus Mon]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. According to a rumor, Mon attempted to capture a flock of Orimanther's [[battlebird]]s, but was initially unsuccessful, so he meditated and created a [[Force storm (weather)|Force storm]], to knock the birds from out of the sky.<ref name="AMA" />
